title: Place Value: Tens and Ones
seo_title: Grade 1 Tens and Ones Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Recognise the place value of two-digit numbers (to 20 or more); decompose two-digit numbers into multiples of tens and ones.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 1 maths worksheets: place value, tens and ones, digits and breaking up two-digit numbers. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A ten is a group of 10 ones.
  • In 34, the 3 means 3 tens (30) and the 4 means 4 ones.
  • 34 = 30 + 4.
  • Compare the tens first.

Examples

Example

2 tens and 6 ones

20 + 6

Answer: 26

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
SwappingThe tens digit is on the left.
A ten as oneOne ten is 10 ones.
Adding digits3 tens 4 ones is 34, not 7.

faq.a: Grade R to Grade 3 in South African schools. Learners are about 6 to 7 years old in Grade 1.

faq.q: What place value is in Grade 1?
faq.a: Tens and ones for numbers up to about 34, and later bigger numbers.
